title: Seed-2 repeat of the capital-through-the-cap results, then all-available + any-signal add
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26). Nothing adopted.
why: Seed 1: stacked (any-signal add + x1.7432) 97.56 PASS; all-available 2,000 95.50 (FAIL vs cs_aro on maxDD only, returns-only PASS); 3,000 114.17 PASS vs 2,000. Training is deterministic per seed; the variance needs another seed. Entries and exits are model-free (width book); the seed changes only the ARO sizer's agree / disagree tags and thresholds.

seed2.procedure: 033 T025a convention: train ARO seed 2 for f00-f14 (research.candidate_training.train --model AROS2 --seed 2; weights by model key, one chain); pick each fold's 0.5-share threshold on the seed-2 model (research.control_sizer.pick --plan plan_cs_aro_s2train.json --seed 2, then --verify --seed 2); copy those thresholds unchanged into the six run plans plan_<arm>_r2.json; run each with run_folds --seed 2. Judge plans plan_<arm>_s2.json carry the _s2 arm tags.
seed2.instrument: all 15 fold records per book; every fold class MODEL_SEED 2; every fold's pick --verify --seed 2 passes; cs_aro_s2 agree share within [0.45, 0.55]; cs_aro_s2 trades_hash differs from cs_aro (seed 1) in >= 1 fold (the seed reached the sizer); all-available books: >= 80% of stakes on min(L x w, fillable cap). Fail -> seed-2 INCONCLUSIVE, no P&L read

seed2.replicates: a question replicates when its seed-2 decision equals seed 1's (Q1 PASS, Q4 FAIL-on-risk / returns-only PASS, Q5 PASS), under both the standard and the returns-only reading. Reported: per-book seed-1 vs seed-2 totals and the two-seed mean gains.
